note: Load form (research/load-harness.md) for L06's loops twins: one host failing per step, the calls the stub receives from that host's caller counted per user request. A twin reports when it makes at least one and a half times the other's calls per request, and at least 2. The tax host's caller retries a 404 (RTY-06), counted as calls per request. The fraud host's caller retries 503 with no cap until the request is abandoned (RTY-01): its count only measures how long the harness waited, so that step judges the share of requests that failed (no answer before k6 gave up at 8 s, against the clean twin's 503 at once), reported at half the requests or more and one and a half times the other's share; the accounts host's caller waits no time between its retries (RTY-03), which changes no count, so under load it is a decoy: the twins make the same calls. The fraud step runs last and the next repeat starts a fresh twin, since its abandoned requests keep retrying. Each step runs at a fixed arrival rate (k6), each twin judged against the other over 3 repeats, every finding under the timing rule. defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other judged step is a decoy, in both twins.
